{c_important}{u}{b}Hellwyrms{/c}{/u}{/b} will always open a {c_important}Chaos Rift{/c}, and enemies that emerge from it gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

The first time a {c_important}Chaos Rift{/c} opens, there is a chance that another will open.
